title: Bacon Ranch Chicken
reject_reason: Baked chicken breasts smothered in creamy ranch sauce with bacon and cheddar is the same bacon-ranch-chicken bake identity as in-flight chicken-bacon-ranch-cauliflower-bake (chicken, bake, ranch-cream, bacon+cheddar — four axes); presence/absence of cauliflower is not a distinct plate.
